scientific_scope: development correctness and scope smoke; not a benchmark, certificate, or SOTA comparison
pass_condition: All 16 float64 candidate intervals contain the independent common_model exact_dp value within 1e-8 and every reusable/root dual has nonpositive recorded feasibility violation.
failure_classification: Any containment, dual-feasibility, target, cost, root, or occupation-marginal failure is implementation_invalid. A wide valid interval is a performance diagnostic only.
nonclaims: The smoke path count, horizon and shift do not replace the frozen final grid
Float64 feasibility is not outward-rounded certification
No timing or gap from this smoke is a SOTA result
